given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner is logged in and viewing their dashboard
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine assigns a new delivery task within their service zone
given_when_then.then: The system displays the delivery slot details including route, estimated arrival time, and item list for the partner to accept or reject

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner has reached their maximum workload capacity
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to assign a new delivery task to that partner
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the assignment and routes the task to another available agent within the same service zone

given_when_then.given: The original agent rejects a delivery task
given_when_then.when: The system processes the rejection event
given_when_then.then: The system permits dynamic reassignment of the delivery task to a different agent

given_when_then.given: A delivery task is assigned and traffic patterns change significantly
given_when_then.when: The system detects the traffic pattern change
given_when_then.then: The system recalculates estimated arrival times for the delivery slot

success_criteria: The Order Allocation Engine successfully assigns delivery tasks based on current workload and proximity.
Delivery slots are not assigned to agents exceeding maximum capacity for their service zone.
The system confirms the delivery slot as active only after explicit acceptance by the agent.
Tasks are dynamically reassigned only when the original agent rejects the task or exceeds capacity limits.
Estimated arrival times are updated when significant changes in traffic patterns occur after initial assignment.
